source.note_posted_date_basis: note title suffix 261127 interpreted as 2026-11-27 Asia/Shanghai; unverified against platform timestamp
source.source_url_basis: derived from note_id; xsec_token omitted from public export
source.post_likes_basis: value shown on the user profile note card at collection time (3 on refreshed profile)

capture_method.readback: User profile loaded in a logged-in RunningCheeseChrome browser (huashu-chrome CDP bridge). Browser was not running at task start; launched D:/Program Files (x86)/RunningCheeseChrome/App/chrome.exe, bridge recovered. Profile tab was RELOADED before extraction to defeat cache. Reloaded DOM exposed newest ranking note 261127 (cover signature 202611270947); card metadata extracted from section.note-item.
capture_method.ocr_preprocessing: cover upscaled 3x with ffmpeg lanczos (640x280 -> 1920x840), then cropped into column slices (tags/title/author+num/comment/dates) at 2x and selected ambiguous glyphs at 3x-6x for disambiguation
capture_method.ocr_uncertainty_note: Book/author names transcribed from a low-resolution embedded table. Ambiguous glyphs flagged medium with per-item ocr_notes (沙雕文豪门霸总 tag, 恨海情天 line, 体教 glyph confirmed by 6x, 嫌, (za) parenthesis). No glyph resolved by guessing. Semantically odd strings (人间体教风吹去, 猫猫攻略手札(za), 求番外多) transcribed verbatim as printed.
capture_method.column7_note: Unlike the 261123/261124/261125 covers (which had NO 弹评 column), THIS cover's 7th column header prints '评论数量' (comment count) with numeric values (428/57/186/...). Per schema the field name is 'danping', so those printed numbers are placed in the 'danping' field verbatim. This is NOT a 弹评 label and NOT fabricated — it is the literal value under the 7th column as printed on this cover.

parsing.ranking_scope: single screenshot of one daily ranking table; not the full platform ranking
parsing.column_semantics_note: likes is the numeric count printed under '喜欢'; danping holds the numeric value printed under this cover's 7th column '评论数量' (see capture_method.column7_note); comment_status is the qualitative label under '评论现状'.
parsing.tags_normalization: original '.' separators rendered as '/' in CSV for readability

analysis_boundary: Single-cover OCR of a third-party public ranking screenshot. Book/author names and counts are best-effort transcription from an embedded low-resolution table, not verified against the original platform; several glyphs flagged medium remain ambiguous. On this cover the 7th column literally prints '评论数量' (comment count), stored in the 'danping' schema field verbatim — it is not an elastic 弹评 label. Qualitative comment_status is the screenshot author's label, not measured data. Do not treat as official ranking or as read book text. No full text of any work is stored.
